items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I needed a tenor player, so Dizzy agreed to go up and play it with us.

ctx.x: Now if you ask me about that hotel in Boston, I don't know because we had played that hotel once before with Chick.
I needed a tenor player, so Dizzy agreed to go up and play it with us. And Dizzy made the four weeks with us.
And after I played the four weeks, I couldn't come to any agreement with Moe Gale -- the agreement that we had on the band --
